covariate_feed.source: run_nf_inj3_injury_games.build_population — the bake-off's OWN builder, not re-derived

excluded.why_rookies: injury_availability_games runs inside project_veterans; project_rookies is a separate frame concatenated afterwards, so the cap STRUCTURALLY cannot act on a rookie (preregistration §3 — out of scope, recorded for carding)
excluded.why_returners: NF-D11's absence prior runs immediately after the injury cap, so a returner's served games compose two caps and this one's contribution is not separably recoverable (preregistration §3)

band_integrity.what_it_is: G4 — the served band must ORDER (p10 <= p90) and BRACKET its own point. The COVERAGE half needs realized outcomes and stays `run_interval_revalidation`'s job (run separately, ALL FLOORS MET); a board rebuild cannot move it.

noise_floor.what_it_is: two builds of the SAME board with IDENTICAL code. A treatment delta is only readable ABOVE this; a rank move is meaningful only if the replicate rank order is identical.

unflagged_collateral.why_it_matters: NF1.5 re-assigns each position's POINT MULTISET in learned-rank order, so moving the flagged players' games moves points onto UNFLAGGED players too. A proportional estimate cannot see this.

superflex.read_separately_because: NF-TR2b — the VOR 'shield' (a per-group level shift cancels because a group's own replacement absorbs it) is ADDITIVE-ONLY and assumes the group is not cross-pooled. QB IS cross-pooled in superflex, so these configs must be read on their own rows, never inferred from the others.
